title: Samsung Galaxy S27 Ultra: Camera Sensor and ISOCELL HPC News
description: Recent reports from PhoneArena, NewsBytes, and GSMArena discuss potential camera features and new sensor technology related to the Samsung Galaxy S27 Ultra.

sections.heading: Potential First Look
paragraphs: PhoneArena published a report questioning whether Samsung has provided the first look at the Galaxy S27 Ultra camera.

sections.heading: 200MP Sensor Capabilities
paragraphs: NewsBytes reported on a new Samsung 200MP camera sensor. According to the source, this sensor is capable of capturing 16-bit RAW photos.

sections.heading: ISOCELL HPC Unveiling
paragraphs: GSMArena.com covered the unveiling of the ISOCELL HPC. The outlet notes that this is Samsung's first sensor to feature DeepPix technology.

faq.q: What did PhoneArena suggest about the Galaxy S27 Ultra?

faq.q: What is the capability of the new 200MP sensor according to NewsBytes?
faq.a: NewsBytes states that Samsung's new 200MP camera sensor can capture 16-bit RAW photos.

faq.q: What is significant about the ISOCELL HPC according to GSMArena.com?
faq.a: According to GSMArena.com, the ISOCELL HPC is Samsung's first sensor with DeepPix technology.
